run_eval_policy: run evaluation of a trained sample factory policy and save rendered episode frames to video
run_visualize_cli: run the sample factory visualization script with a config path to generate policy evaluation videos
create_actor_critic_model: create an actor-critic model from sample factory config and environment observation and action spaces
load_checkpoint_policy: load a trained policy checkpoint using LearnerWorker and apply it to an actor-critic model
render_episode_frames: render environment frames during policy evaluation and save them as MP4 animation files
